headline: Android is getting its own weird dots to cure car sickness
summary: Google rolls out Motion Assist for Android. This feature aims to reduce motion sickness in vehicles. It functions similarly to Apple's Motion Cues.

headline: Lenovo confirms Legion Go issues after gamers report bricked devices
summary: Lenovo acknowledges reports of bricked Legion Go devices. A bad software update is causing the widespread issue. A debate sparks over whether fixes should be free.

headline: The cat-and-mouse game over 3D-printed guns has begun
summary: The creator of the first 3D-printed gun claims a breakthrough. He's found a way to bypass government-mandated printing blocks. This signals an escalating battle against ghost guns.

headline: Zillow and Redfin settle FTC antitrust case over their rental listings partnership
summary: Zillow and Redfin reach a settlement with the FTC. The case alleged antitrust violations in their 2025 partnership. Accusations centered on stifling competition for multifamily listings.

headline: Batman: Knightfall Part 1 Is Now Available to Watch Online
summary: Batman: Knightfall Part 1 is now available for viewing. Fans can stream the content online immediately. It's also accessible on 4K Blu-ray.

headline: Newegg Has the Least Overpriced 32GB of DDR5 6000MHz CL 30 Desktop Memory
summary: Newegg offers competitively priced 32GB DDR5 RAM. This memory is ideal for AMD Ryzen gaming builds. It boasts 6000MHz CL 30 specifications.

headline: Get a 1,000W 48V Adult Electric Bike With 28mph Top Speed and 80 Mile Range for Just $275 Shipped
summary: An adult electric bike is available for only $275. It features a powerful 1,000W motor and 48V battery. Enjoy a 28mph top speed and 80-mile range.

headline: The Witcher 3 Songs of the Past Expansion Confirmed to Include More Gwent, and Everyone Is Already Celebrating
summary: The Witcher 3's new expansion, 'Songs of the Past,' is confirmed. It will feature additional Gwent content. Card game fans are already celebrating the news.

headline: Iran says it is 'fully prepared' to counter widened US economic sanctions
summary: Iran states full readiness to counter new US sanctions. The US calls its latest measures an 'economic D-Day'. Tehran claims to have a strategy to address the impact.

headline: More than 70,000 social and affordable homes to be built across England over 10 years
summary: Over 70,000 new affordable homes are planned for England. Construction will span the next decade. Major funding is allocated to London and regional areas.

headline: Lockerbie bombing trial postponed days before it was due to start
summary: The Lockerbie bombing trial has been postponed. It's the third delay, occurring days before its start. New evidence emerged, impacting the 37-year-old case.

headline: Beyond China's humanoid robots, a quieter machine revolution is unfolding
summary: China is undergoing a rapid industrial robot expansion. Over two million robots now operate in Chinese factories. This quiet machine revolution is scaling up fast.
